name: movmais
description: Mov+ connects ChatGPT to your Mov+ workspace: sales analytics, customers, products and price tables, orders, technical assistance, finance, CRM and projects. Read-only by default; writes only when you enable them during authorization.

interface.longDescription:
Mov+ is a multi-tenant business platform for Brazilian companies: sales analytics over the company's ERP, customers, products and price tables, sales orders, technical assistance, finance, CRM, projects and boards.

This app connects ChatGPT to YOUR Mov+ workspace so you can ask questions in plain language and get answers computed by Mov+ itself (the same numbers as the Mov+ screens), instead of guessing from exports.

What you can do:
- Sales analytics: sales for a period, over time, by customer, product, representative, state, city and portfolio; the sales ranking.
- Customers: search customers, open a customer record, list customers who stopped buying (base active in the last 12 months by default), customers with overdue invoices, a customer PDF.
- Products and prices: search the catalog, see a product, get the price for a specific customer, current commercial rules.
- Orders: search orders, order details, a PDF or spreadsheet of an order, and create a DRAFT that repeats a previous order. Creating or editing a draft never touches your ERP. Sending an order is a separate, explicit step; only companies that turned on direct sending in Mov+ have the order forwarded to the ERP (as an unconfirmed order). Mov+ never confirms, invoices or deletes anything in your ERP.
- Technical assistance: search claims, indicators, media and the claim PDF.
- Finance, CRM, projects, boards, documents and files: list and summarize; create records when writes are enabled.
- Alerts and daily tips: create alerts, summaries and daily tips and manage the notifications you receive.

How access works:
- You sign in to Mov+ with your own account and choose the workspace and the modules to share. Authorization uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; there are no API keys to copy.
- The app can only see what YOUR Mov+ user is allowed to see (permissions, branch and sales-scope rules are the same as in the Mov+ screens).
- Write tools are OFF by default. They appear only if you turn on writes in the authorization screen. Every write is recorded in the Mov+ audit log.
- You can revoke access at any time in Mov+ (Settings > MCP) and the connection stops immediately.

Requirements: an active Mov+ account with a workspace, and the permission to manage MCP credentials (settings.actions.manage_mcp) to authorize the connection.

Mov+ is available in Portuguese (Brazil). Amounts are in Brazilian reais.
capabilities: Sales analytics by period, customer, product and representative
Customer search and customers who stopped buying
Order search, order PDF and draft orders
Finance, CRM, projects and boards (writes optional)
defaultPrompt: Quais foram as vendas deste mês?
Mostre os clientes sem comprar há 60 dias
Crie um rascunho repetindo o último pedido do cliente X

positive.description: Sales summary for the current month (read-only analytics).
positive.prompt: Quais foram as vendas deste mês?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls analytics.vendas_resumo for the current month and answers with the total sales in reais. No data is created or changed.

positive.description: Customers who stopped buying, with the 60-day filter.
positive.prompt: Mostre os clientes sem comprar há 60 dias, dos que mais compram para os que menos compram
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls analytics.clientes_parados with at least 60 days without buying and lists the customers ordered by 12-month sales, highest first.

positive.prompt: Qual é o ranking de vendas por representante neste trimestre?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls analytics.ranking_vendas for the quarter and lists the representatives ordered by sales, in reais.

positive.description: Find a customer and a product, then get the customer-specific price (chained read tools).
positive.prompt: Busque o cliente Adega Ipê e o produto Iogurte natural 170g e diga o preço desse produto para esse cliente
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the customer and the product with the two search tools, then calls produtos.preco_para_cliente and reports the price of that product for that customer.

positive.description: Write with authorization: create a DRAFT order that repeats a previous order. The reviewer must turn on the "Deixar o agente gravar" (allow the agent to write) switch on the Mov+ authorization screen when connecting; without it no write tool is offered (see notes for the reviewer).
positive.prompt: Crie um rascunho repetindo o último pedido do cliente Adega Ipê
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the customer's latest order with pedidos.buscar_pedidos, then calls pedidos.replicar_pedido, which creates a new draft order (nothing is sent) and returns its code.

negative.description: Write requested while the connection was authorized WITHOUT writes: no write tool is offered, so the assistant must say it cannot create the record and must not pretend it did.
negative.prompt: Crie um lançamento de despesa de R$ 500 chamado Material de escritório

negative.description: Data from another company: the connection is bound to the one workspace chosen at authorization and no tool accepts another workspace, so the assistant cannot read it and must say so.
negative.prompt: Mostre as vendas do mês da empresa concorrente Acme Ltda, que usa outro workspace do Mov+

negative.description: Destructive action the app does not offer: there is no tool to delete financial records or orders, so the assistant must decline and not invent a workaround.
negative.prompt: Apague todos os lançamentos financeiros do mês passado

publication.release_notes: First release: sales analytics, customers, products and prices, orders (draft), technical assistance, finance, CRM, projects. OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; writes off by default.

pt-BR.subtitle: IA para vendas e operação
pt-BR.description:
O Mov+ é uma plataforma para empresas brasileiras: análises de venda sobre o ERP, clientes, produtos e tabelas de preço, pedidos, assistência técnica, financeiro, CRM e projetos.

Este app conecta o ChatGPT ao SEU workspace do Mov+: você pergunta em linguagem natural e recebe números calculados pelo próprio Mov+ (os mesmos das telas).

O que dá para fazer:
- Análise de vendas por período, cliente, produto, representante, estado, cidade e carteira; ranking de vendas.
- Clientes: buscar, ver a ficha, listar quem parou de comprar, quem tem título vencido.
- Produtos e preços: catálogo, preço para um cliente, regras comerciais vigentes.
- Pedidos: buscar, detalhar, PDF ou planilha e criar um RASCUNHO repetindo um pedido anterior. Criar ou editar um rascunho nunca toca o seu ERP. Enviar o pedido é outro passo, explícito; só as empresas que ligaram o envio direto no Mov+ têm o pedido encaminhado ao ERP (como pedido não confirmado). O Mov+ nunca confirma, fatura nem exclui nada no seu ERP.
- Assistência técnica, financeiro, CRM, projetos, boards, documentos e arquivos.

Como funciona o acesso: você entra com a sua conta do Mov+, escolhe o workspace e os módulos (OAuth 2.1 com PKCE, sem chave para copiar). O app só vê o que o SEU usuário pode ver. A escrita nasce DESLIGADA e só existe se você ligá-la na tela de autorização; toda gravação fica na auditoria. Você revoga quando quiser em Configurações > MCP.

Pré-requisito: conta ativa no Mov+ com workspace e permissão para gerenciar credenciais MCP.
